   [solve worker-1]           "content": "# Engagement B1 — TON Testnet Deployment & Validation\n\n**Engagement ID:** `B1`\n**Issue:** [#117 — B1 Testnet Deployment & Validation](https://github.com/xlabtg/tonbankcard-protocol/issues/117)\n**Roadmap track:** B — Production Deployment & Operations\n**Status:** Engagement preparation complete — awaiting deployer multi-sig and credentialed run\n**Maintainer:** `@konard`\n**Last Updated:** 2026-05-16\n\n---\n\n## 1. Objective\n\nDeploy all in-scope Phase 2 and Phase 4 smart contracts to **TON testnet**, populate the canonical contract registry with the resulting addresses, and run the full validation suite (end-to-end payment flow, gateway adapters, indexer) against those live testnet contracts.\n\nThe engagement is the **last gate before**:\n\n- A1 / A2 auditors begin live testing — they typically point at deployed testnet contracts ([engagement A1](../../security/audits/A1-core-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md), [engagement A2](../../security/audits/A2-phase4-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md)).\n- B2 mainnet deployment — testnet validation must succeed before any mainnet contract is initialised (see [`README.md` §4 gating rules](../../security/audits/README.md)).\n\nSuccess criteria mirror the acceptance criteria in issue #117 §8:\n\n- [ ] All Phase 2 contracts deployed to TON testnet\n- [ ] Phase 4 contracts deployed to TON testnet (for testing only)\n- [ ] [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) updated with all testnet contract addresses\n- [ ] End-to-end integration test suite passes against testnet contracts\n- [ ] All backend adapters validated against sandbox/testnet gateways\n- [ ] Indexer correctly indexes testnet payment events\n- [ ] Deployment script (`scripts/deploy/`) documented and validated\n\n---\n\n## 2. In-Scope Contracts\n\nExactly the contract sets enumerated in issue #117 §3. Phase 2 and Phase 4 are deployed in two passes — Phase 2 first (it is a dependency for end-to-end validation and for A1), Phase 4 second (gated on Phase 2 validation passing).\n\n### 2.1 Phase 2 — Core protocol\n\n| # | Contract | File | Language | Dependencies |\n|---|----------|------|----------|--------------|\n| 1 | `AccountLocks` | `contracts/payments/account-locks.fc` | FunC | — |\n| 2 | `NFTAccountResolver` (FunC + Tact) | `contracts/nft-resolver/nft_account_resolver.fc` / `.tact` | FunC, Tact | — |\n| 3 | `AccountStateMachine` | `contracts/payment-hub/account-state.tact` | Tact | `AccountLocks` |\n| 4 | `PaymentHub` | `contracts/payments/PaymentHub.tact` | Tact | `AccountLocks`, `NFTAccountResolver`, `AccountStateMachine` |\n| 5 | `MerchantPaymentHub` | `contracts/MerchantPaymentHub.tact` | Tact | `PaymentHub` |\n| 6 | `CollateralSignal` | `contracts/CollateralSignal.tact` | Tact | — |\n| 7 | `PublicCollateralLookup` | `contracts/collateral-lookup/PublicCollateralLookup.tact` | Tact | `CollateralSignal` |\n| 8 | `ProposalRegistry` | `contracts/governance/ProposalRegistry.tact` | Tact | — |\n| 9 | `SnapshotVerifier` | `contracts/governance/SnapshotVerifier.tact` | Tact | — |\n| 10 | `TransparencyRegistry` | `contracts/governance/TransparencyRegistry.tact` | Tact | — |\n\nThe deterministic deployment order is canonicalised in [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) §3 and enforced by [`scripts/deploy/deploy.ts`](../../../scripts/deploy/deploy.ts).\n\n### 2.2 Phase 4 — Advanced features (testnet only)\n\n| # | Contract | File | Notes |\n|---|----------|------|-------|\n| 1 | `CrossChainBridge` | `contracts/CrossChainBridge.tact` | Testnet only; mainnet blocked on A2 |\n| 2 | `MultiSigCard` | `contracts/MultiSigCard.tact` | Testnet only; mainnet blocked on A2 |\n| 3 | `RecurringPayments` | `contracts/RecurringPayments.tact` | Testnet only; mainnet blocked on A2 |\n| 4 | `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | `contracts/LendingProtocolCoordinator.tact` | Testnet only; mainnet blocked on A2 |\n\nPhase 4 testnet deployments are explicitly labelled **`testing-only`** in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) and **must not** be referenced by any mainnet manifest before A2 sign-off (see [engagement A2 §1](../../security/audits/A2-phase4-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md)).\n\n### 2.3 Services & adapters validated against the testnet deployment\n\n| Component | Path | Validation owner |\n|-----------|------|------------------|\n| Merchant API | [`api/`](../../../api/) | [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §3 |\n| Payment indexer | [`backend/indexer/`](../../../backend/indexer/) | [`INDEXER_VALIDATION.md`](./INDEXER_VALIDATION.md) |\n| Gateway adapters | [`backend/adapters/`](../../../backend/adapters/) | [`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md) |\n| Merchant SDK | [`sdk/`](../../../sdk/) | [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §4 |\n\n---\n\n## 3. Out of Scope\n\nExplicitly **not** part of this engagement:\n\n- Mainnet deployment of any contract — covered by **B2** (`scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network mainnet --confirm`).\n- Mainnet deployment of Phase 4 contracts — additionally blocked on engagement [A2](../../security/audits/A2-phase4-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md).\n- Production API keys for gateway adapters — sandbox/testnet keys only (see [§7](#7-security-requirements)).\n- Faucet operation for public testers — out of scope here; planned as part of roadmap **C3** (Test Sandbox Environment).\n- Production monitoring & alerting — covered by **B3**.\n\nExternal pre-deployed mainnet contracts (TBC jetton, Series 7777/8888 NFT collections, TONCO TBC/TON pool) are not redeployed; their testnet equivalents are documented as **trust assumptions** in [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) §6.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Upstream Gates\n\nThe engagement may begin once all rows below are ✅. The live state of each gate is mirrored in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §2.\n\n| # | Gate | Owner | Evidence |\n|---|------|-------|----------|\n| G-1 | Contracts build cleanly on the frozen commit | `@konard` | `npx blueprint build` succeeds on commit recorded in [`audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md`](../../../audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md) |\n| G-2 | Internal pre-audit findings remediated (F-CRIT-1 … F-CRIT-5) | `@konard` | [`docs/audit/FULL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md`](../../audit/FULL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md) §\"Status\" |\n| G-3 | Formal invariant suite passes (I1–I7) | `@konard` | [`tests/invariants/`](../../../tests/invariants/) green on the deploy commit |\n| G-4 | Deployer multi-sig provisioned with at least 2-of-3 signers | `@konard` | Cold-storage signers documented in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3 |\n| G-5 | Testnet faucet funded for deployer | `@konard` | Faucet balance ≥ deployment budget recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §4 |\n| G-6 | D6 Acton/Tolk evaluation note recorded | `@konard` | See §10 — decision committed before kickoff |\n\nIf any gate is ❌ at kickoff the engagement is paused and the unmet gate is owned in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §11 (\"Open questions / blockers\").\n\n---\n\n## 5. Engagement Package\n\nThe deployment operator receives the following frozen package at kickoff. Hashes and locations are tracked in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §10.\n\n| Artifact | Location | Purpose |\n|----------|----------|---------|\n| Deployment plan | [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) | Per-contract initialisation parameters, dependency order |\n| Operational runbook | [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) | Step-by-step deploy procedure (idempotent, multi-sig) |\n| Validation plan | [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) | End-to-end payment flow scenarios on the live deployment |\n| Gateway validation matrix | [`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md) | Per-adapter sandbox test cases |\n| Indexer validation plan | [`INDEXER_VALIDATION.md`](./INDEXER_VALIDATION.md) | Event coverage, reorg handling, replay protection |\n| Manifest template | [`MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json`](./MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json) | Canonical layout for `deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` |\n| Network matrix | [`../network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) | Authoritative registry — updated after deploy |\n| Existing contracts | [`../../existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) | Public summary — updated after deploy |\n| Build instructions | [`../../../audit/BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md`](../../../audit/BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md) | Reproducible build commands |\n| Freeze metadata | [`../../../audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md`](../../../audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md) | Compiler versions and frozen commit |\n\nThe deploy commit is recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3 and must match `audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md` so that the testnet addresses are auditable against the same source as A1/A2.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Engagement Process\n\n```\nT-0   Engagement plan committed                                            ✅ (this directory)\nT+0   All upstream gates G-1 … G-6 closed                                   ⏳\nT+0d  Phase 2 dry run on testnet sandbox (--dry-run, no signing)            ⏳\nT+1d  Phase 2 multi-sig deploy + manifest written + post-deploy verify     ⏳\nT+1d  Update `docs/existing-contracts.md` and `docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`\nT+2d  End-to-end validation pass (VALIDATION_PLAN.md §2 — happy paths)      ⏳\nT+2d  Gateway adapter validation pass (GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md)               ⏳\nT+3d  Indexer validation pass (INDEXER_VALIDATION.md)                       ⏳\nT+3d  Phase 2 sign-off recorded in STATUS.md                                ⏳\nT+4d  Phase 4 dry run                                                       ⏳\nT+4d  Phase 4 multi-sig deploy (testnet-only label)                         ⏳\nT+5d  Phase 4 validation pass + sign-off                                    ⏳\nT+5d  CI integration suite green against testnet (`tests/integration:testnet`) ⏳\nT+5d  STATUS.md gating verdict flipped to READY-FOR-B2                      ⏳\n```\n\nPhase 4 testnet deployment is **only initiated after Phase 2 is signed off**. If any validation in Phase 2 reports a Critical or High failure, the engagement pauses and the issue is filed per the standard workflow before Phase 4 begins.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Security Requirements\n\nThe following constraints from issue #117 §7 are non-negotiable:\n\n1. **Key separation.** Testnet deployer key MUST be a distinct multi-sig (or hardware wallet) separate from any mainnet key. See [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §2 for the key-provisioning checklist and [`docs/security/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md`](../../security/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md).\n2. **No secret material in the repo.** Deployer mnemonics, API keys for gateways, and indexer credentials must be loaded via environment variables only. [`scripts/deploy/deploy.ts`](../../../scripts/deploy/deploy.ts) reads `ADMIN_ADDRESS`, `RISK_AUTHORITY_ADDRESS`, `LENDING_ADAPTER_ADDRESS` and refuses to deploy without them.\n3. **Phase 4 contracts are testnet-only.** Each Phase 4 manifest entry carries `\"environment\": \"testnet-only\"` (see [`MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json`](./MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json)). They MUST NOT be referenced from any mainnet manifest before A2 verdict = `READY` (see [engagement A2 §9](../../security/audits/A2-phase4-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md)).\n4. **Gateway sandboxes only.** Adapter validation uses the providers' sandbox or testnet endpoints. Production API keys must not be loaded into the test environment ([`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md) §2 documents the exact endpoints).\n5. **Auditable trail.** Every deployment writes a manifest to `deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` and is verified by [`scripts/deploy/verify.ts`](../../../scripts/deploy/verify.ts) before sign-off.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Non-Functional Requirements\n\nMirror of issue #117 §6:\n\n| # | Requirement | Where enforced |\n|---|-------------|----------------|\n| NFR-1 | Deployment scripts idempotent (safe to re-run) | [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §4 — re-run produces an identical manifest for the same commit |\n| NFR-2 | All deployed addresses documented and committed | Post-deploy step in [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §6 updates the existing-contracts doc and network matrix in the same PR |\n| NFR-3 | CI integration tests pass against testnet | `npm run test:integration:testnet` documented in [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §6 |\n| NFR-4 | Multi-sig deployment for mainnet-referenced addresses | [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §3.2 — single-key deployment is rejected for Phase 2 |\n\n---\n\n## 9. Acceptance / Gating Decision\n\nThe engagement is closed when:\n\n- All seven checkboxes in §1 are ticked.\n- [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) records the gating verdict as `READY-FOR-B2` or `READY-FOR-B2 WITH ACCEPTED RISKS`.\n- [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) and [`docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) carry the testnet addresses.\n- `CHANGELOG.md` carries a disclosure entry referencing the deployed addresses.\n\nA verdict of `BLOCKED` keeps mainnet deployment paused per the same gating rule as audits A1 / A2 ([`docs/security/audits/README.md`](../../security/audits/README.md) §4).\n\n---\n\n## 10. D6 — Acton / Tolk Toolchain Evaluation\n\nPer issue #117 §5(5): if engagement **D6** (Acton/Tolk toolchain evaluation, see [`TEMP/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md`](../../../TEMP/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md)) approves Acton for any Tolk-based deployment prototype before B1 kickoff, the verdict must be recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §6 and explicitly state whether the prototype **supplements** or **replaces** the existing `scripts/deploy/` path for testnet only.\n\nUntil D6 produces a verdict, the canonical deployment path remains `scripts/deploy/deploy.ts` driven by `@ton/blueprint`. Mainnet is **never** in scope of any D6 prototype before A1 / A2 are signed off.\n\n---\n\n## 11. Objective\n\nDeploy all in-scope Phase 2 and Phase 4 smart contracts to **TON testnet**, populate the canonical contract registry with the resulting addresses, and run the full validation suite (end-to-end payment flow, gateway adapters, indexer) against those live testnet contracts.\n\nThe engagement is the **last gate before**:\n\n- A1 / A2 auditors begin live testing — they typically point at deployed testnet contracts ([engagement A1](../../security/audits/A1-core-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md), [engagement A2](../../security/audits/A2-phase4-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md)).\n- B2 mainnet deployment — testnet validation must succeed before any mainnet contract is initialised (see [`README.md` §4 gating rules](../../security/audits/README.md)).\n\nSuccess criteria mirror the acceptance criteria in issue #117 §8:\n\n- [ ] All Phase 2 contracts deployed to TON testnet\n- [ ] Phase 4 contracts deployed to TON testnet (for testing only)\n- [ ] [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) updated with all testnet contract addresses\n- [ ] End-to-end integration test suite passes against testnet contracts\n- [ ] All backend adapters validated against sandbox/testnet gateways\n- [ ] Indexer correctly indexes testnet payment events\n- [ ] Deployment script (`scripts/deploy/`) documented and validated\n\n---\n\n## 2. In-Scope Contracts\n\nExactly the contract sets enumerated in issue #117 §3. Phase 2 and Phase 4 are deployed in two passes — Phase 2 first (it is a dependency for end-to-end validation and for A1), Phase 4 second (gated on Phase 2 validation passing).\n\n### 2.1 Phase 2 — Core protocol\n\n| # | Contract | File | Language | Dependencies |\n|---|----------|------|----------|--------------|\n| 1 | `AccountLocks` | `contracts/payments/account-locks.fc` | FunC | — |\n| 2 | `NFTAccountResolver` (FunC + Tact) | `contracts/nft-resolver/nft_account_resolver.fc` / `.tact` | FunC, Tact | — |\n| 3 | `AccountStateMachine` | `contracts/payment-hub/account-state.tact` | Tact | `AccountLocks` |\n| 4 | `PaymentHub` | `contracts/payments/PaymentHub.tact` | Tact | `AccountLocks`, `NFTAccountResolver`, `AccountStateMachine` |\n| 5 | `MerchantPaymentHub` | `contracts/MerchantPaymentHub.tact` | Tact | `PaymentHub` |\n| 6 | `CollateralSignal` | `contracts/CollateralSignal.tact` | Tact | — |\n| 7 | `PublicCollateralLookup` | `contracts/collateral-lookup/PublicCollateralLookup.tact` | Tact | `CollateralSignal` |\n| 8 | `ProposalRegistry` | `contracts/governance/ProposalRegistry.tact` | Tact | — |\n| 9 | `SnapshotVerifier` | `contracts/governance/SnapshotVerifier.tact` | Tact | — |\n| 10 | `TransparencyRegistry` | `contracts/governance/TransparencyRegistry.tact` | Tact | — |\n\nThe deterministic deployment order is canonicalised in [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) §3 and enforced by [`scripts/deploy/deploy.ts`](../../../scripts/deploy/deploy.ts).\n\n### 2.2 Phase 4 — Advanced features (testnet only)\n\n| # | Contract | File | Notes |\n|---|----------|------|-------|\n| 1 | `CrossChainBridge` | `contracts/CrossChainBridge.tact` | Testnet only; mainnet blocked on A2 |\n\nPhase 4 testnet deployments are explicitly labelled **`testing-only`** in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) and **must not** be referenced by any mainnet manifest before A2 sign-off (see [engagement A2 §1](../../security/audits/A2-phase4-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md)).\n\n### 2.3 Services & adapters validated against the testnet deployment\n\n| Component | Path | Validation owner |\n|-----------|------|------------------|\n| Merchant API | [`api/`](../../../api/) | [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §3 |\n| Payment indexer | [`backend/indexer/`](../../../backend/indexer/) | [`INDEXER_VALIDATION.md`](./INDEXER_VALIDATION.md) |\n| Gateway adapters | [`backend/adapters/`](../../../backend/adapters/) | [`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md) |\n| Merchant SDK | [`sdk/`](../../../sdk/) | [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §4 |\n\n---\n\n## 3. Out of Scope\n\nExplicitly **not** part of this engagement:\n\n- Mainnet deployment of any contract — covered by **B2** (`scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network mainnet --confirm`).\n- Mainnet deployment of Phase 4 contracts — additionally blocked on engagement [A2](../../security/audits/A2-phase4-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md).\n- Production API keys for gateway adapters — sandbox/testnet keys only (see [§7](#7-security-requirements)).\n- Faucet operation for public testers — out of scope here; planned as part of roadmap **C3** (Test Sandbox Environment).\n- Production monitoring & alerting — covered by **B3**.\n\nExternal pre-deployed mainnet contracts (TBC jetton, Series 7777/8888 NFT collections, TONCO TBC/TON pool) are not redeployed; their testnet equivalents are documented as **trust assumptions** in [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) §6.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Upstream Gates\n\nThe engagement may begin once all rows below are ✅. The live state of each gate is mirrored in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §2.\n\n| # | Gate | Owner | Evidence |\n|---|------|-------|----------|\n| G-1 | Contracts build cleanly on the frozen commit | `@konard` | `npx blueprint build` succeeds on commit recorded in [`audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md`](../../../audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md) |\n| G-2 | Internal pre-audit findings remediated (F-CRIT-1 … F-CRIT-5) | `@konard` | [`docs/audit/FULL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md`](../../audit/FULL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md) §\"Status\" |\n| G-3 | Formal invariant suite passes (I1–I7) | `@konard` | [`tests/invariants/`](../../../tests/invariants/) green on the deploy commit |\n| G-4 | Deployer multi-sig provisioned with at least 2-of-3 signers | `@konard` | Cold-storage signers documented in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3 |\n| G-5 | Testnet faucet funded for deployer | `@konard` | Faucet balance ≥ deployment budget recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §4 |\n| G-6 | D6 Acton/Tolk evaluation note recorded | `@konard` | See §10 — decision committed before kickoff |\n\nIf any gate is ❌ at kickoff the engagement is paused and the unmet gate is owned in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §11 (\"Open questions / blockers\").\n\n---\n\n## 5. Engagement Package\n\nThe deployment operator receives the following frozen package at kickoff. Hashes and locations are tracked in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §10.\n\n| Artifact | Location | Purpose |\n|----------|----------|---------|\n| Deployment plan | [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) | Per-contract initialisation parameters, dependency order |\n| Operational runbook | [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) | Step-by-step deploy procedure (idempotent, multi-sig) |\n| Validation plan | [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) | End-to-end payment flow scenarios on the live deployment |\n| Gateway validation matrix | [`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md) | Per-adapter sandbox test cases |\n| Indexer validation plan | [`INDEXER_VALIDATION.md`](./INDEXER_VALIDATION.md) | Event coverage, reorg handling, replay protection |\n| Manifest template | [`MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json`](./MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json) | Canonical layout for `deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` |\n| Network matrix | [`../network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) | Authoritative registry — updated after deploy |\n| Existing contracts | [`../../existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) | Public summary — updated after deploy |\n| Build instructions | [`../../../audit/BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md`](../../../audit/BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md) | Reproducible build commands |\n| Freeze metadata | [`../../../audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md`](../../../audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md) | Compiler versions and frozen commit |\n\nThe deploy commit is recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3 and must match `audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md` so that the testnet addresses are auditable against the same source as A1/A2.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Engagement Process\n\n```\nT-0   Engagement plan committed                                            ✅ (this directory)\nT+0   All upstream gates G-1 … G-6 closed                                   ⏳\nT+0d  Phase 2 dry run on testnet sandbox (--dry-run, no signing)            ⏳\nT+1d  Phase 2 multi-sig deploy + manifest written + post-deploy verify     ⏳\nT+1d  Update `docs/existing-contracts.md` and `docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`\nT+2d  End-to-end validation pass (VALIDATION_PLAN.md §2 — happy paths)      ⏳\nT+2d  Gateway adapter validation pass (GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md)               ⏳\nT+3d  Indexer validation pass (INDEXER_VALIDATION.md)                       ⏳\nT+3d  Phase 2 sign-off recorded in STATUS.md                                ⏳\nT+4d  Phase 4 dry run                                                       ⏳\nT+4d  Phase 4 multi-sig deploy (testnet-only label)                         ⏳\nT+5d  Phase 4 validation pass + sign-off                                    ⏳\nT+5d  CI integration suite green against testnet (`tests/integration:testnet`) ⏳\nT+5d  STATUS.md gating verdict flipped to READY-FOR-B2                      ⏳\n```\n\nPhase 4 testnet deployment is **only initiated after Phase 2 is signed off**. If any validation in Phase 2 reports a Critical or High failure, the engagement pauses and the issue is filed per the standard workflow before Phase 4 begins.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Security Requirements\n\nThe following constraints from issue #117 §7 are non-negotiable:\n\n1. **Key separation.** Testnet deployer key MUST be a distinct multi-sig (or hardware wallet) separate from any mainnet key. See [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §2 for the key-provisioning checklist and [`docs/security/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md`](../../security/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md).\n2. **No secret material in the repo.** Deployer mnemonics, API keys for gateways, and indexer credentials must be loaded via environment variables only. [`scripts/deploy/deploy.ts`](../../../scripts/deploy/deploy.ts) reads `ADMIN_ADDRESS`, `RISK_AUTHORITY_ADDRESS`, `LENDING_ADAPTER_ADDRESS` and refuses to deploy without them.\n3. **Phase 4 contracts are testnet-only.** Each Phase 4 manifest entry carries `\"environment\": \"testnet-only\"` (see [`MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json`](./MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json)). They MUST NOT be referenced from any mainnet manifest before A2 verdict = `READY` (see [engagement A2 §9](../../security/audits/A2-phase4-contracts/ENGAGEMENT.md)).\n4. **Gateway sandboxes only.** Adapter validation uses the providers' sandbox or testnet endpoints. Production API keys must not be loaded into the test environment ([`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md) §2 documents the exact endpoints).\n5. **Auditable trail.** Every deployment writes a manifest to `deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` and is verified by [`scripts/deploy/verify.ts`](../../../scripts/deploy/verify.ts) before sign-off.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Non-Functional Requirements\n\nMirror of issue #117 §6:\n\n| # | Requirement | Where enforced |\n|---|-------------|----------------|\n| NFR-1 | Deployment scripts idempotent (safe to re-run) | [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §4 — re-run produces an identical manifest for the same commit |\n| NFR-2 | All deployed addresses documented and committed | Post-deploy step in [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §6 updates the existing-contracts doc and network matrix in the same PR |\n| NFR-3 | CI integration tests pass against testnet | `npm run test:integration:testnet` documented in [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §6 |\n| NFR-4 | Multi-sig deployment for mainnet-referenced addresses | [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §3.2 — single-key deployment is rejected for Phase 2 |\n\n---\n\n## 9. Acceptance / Gating Decision\n\nThe engagement is closed when:\n\n- All seven checkboxes in §1 are ticked.\n- [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) records the gating verdict as `READY-FOR-B2` or `READY-FOR-B2 WITH ACCEPTED RISKS`.\n- [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) and [`docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) carry the testnet addresses.\n- `CHANGELOG.md` carries a disclosure entry referencing the deployed addresses.\n\nA verdict of `BLOCKED` keeps mainnet deployment paused per the same gating rule as audits A1 / A2 ([`docs/security/audits/README.md`](../../security/audits/README.md) §4).\n\n---\n\n## 10. D6 — Acton / Tolk Toolchain Evaluation\n\nPer issue #117 §5(5): if engagement **D6** (Acton/Tolk toolchain evaluation, see [`TEMP/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md`](../../../TEMP/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md)) approves Acton for any Tolk-based deployment prototype before B1 kickoff, the verdict must be recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §6 and explicitly state whether the prototype **supplements** or **replaces** the existing `scripts/deploy/` path for testnet only.\n\nUntil D6 produces a verdict, the canonical deployment path remains `scripts/deploy/deploy.ts` driven by `@ton/blueprint`. Mainnet is **never** in scope of any D6 prototype before A1 / A2 are signed off.\n\n---\n\n## 11. Purpose\n\nThis document is the per-contract deployment recipe for the TON testnet. It specifies:\n\n- The deterministic order in which contracts are deployed.\n- The exact init parameters each contract requires.\n- Cross-contract address wiring (where a downstream contract must learn the address of an upstream one).\n- The trust assumptions for pre-existing testnet artefacts (TBC jetton, NFT collections, TONCO pool).\n\nIt is read together with the operational [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md). The runbook describes *how* to deploy; this document describes *what* is deployed.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Authoritative source\n\nThe deterministic order encoded in [`scripts/deploy/deploy.ts`](../../../scripts/deploy/deploy.ts) (`DEPLOYMENT_ORDER` constant) is the canonical sequence. This document mirrors that order and may not diverge from it. Any change in deployment topology requires a parallel change to `deploy.ts` and a re-published manifest template.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Deployment order (Phase 2)\n\nContracts are deployed in dependency order so that each downstream contract receives the upstream addresses at construction time. Idempotency is guaranteed by deterministic addressing — re-running `deploy.ts` on the same commit produces the same addresses (see [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §4).\n\n```\n1. AccountLocks                (no dependencies)\n2. NFTAccountResolver          (no dependencies)\n3. AccountStateMachine         (depends on AccountLocks)\n4. PaymentHub                  (depends on AccountLocks, NFTAccountResolver, AccountStateMachine)\n5. MerchantPaymentHub          (depends on PaymentHub)\n6. CollateralSignal            (no dependencies)\n7. PublicCollateralLookup      (depends on CollateralSignal)\n8. ProposalRegistry            (no dependencies — governance group)\n9. SnapshotVerifier            (no dependencies — governance group)\n10. TransparencyRegistry       (no dependencies — governance group)\n```\n\n### 3.1 Per-contract init parameters\n\n| # | Contract | Init parameter | Source | Notes |\n|---|----------|----------------|--------|-------|\n| 1 | `AccountLocks` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var (testnet multi-sig) | Owner for `set_lock` / `clear_lock` only. Cannot move user funds (I3). |\n| 1 | `AccountLocks` | `risk_authority` | `RISK_AUTHORITY_ADDRESS` env var | Independent custody from `admin`. |\n| 2 | `NFTAccountResolver` | `nft_collection_series7777` | Pre-existing mainnet address `EQAjH...` resolves on mainnet only. Testnet collection address is provisioned at kickoff and recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7. |\n| 2 | `NFTAccountResolver` | `nft_collection_series8888` | Same as above |\n| 3 | `AccountStateMachine` | `account_locks` | Address from step 1 |\n| 3 | `AccountStateMachine` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n| 4 | `PaymentHub` | `account_locks` | Address from step 1 |\n| 4 | `PaymentHub` | `nft_account_resolver` | Address from step 2 |\n| 4 | `PaymentHub` | `account_state_machine` | Address from step 3 |\n| 4 | `PaymentHub` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var — strictly limited to allow-listing NFT collections (no fund authority — I3) |\n| 5 | `MerchantPaymentHub` | `payment_hub` | Address from step 4 |\n| 5 | `MerchantPaymentHub` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n| 6 | `CollateralSignal` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n| 7 | `PublicCollateralLookup` | `collateral_signal` | Address from step 6 |\n| 8 | `ProposalRegistry` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n| 9 | `SnapshotVerifier` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n| 10 | `TransparencyRegistry` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n\nPer-contract `notes` in the table reference the protocol invariants `I1`–`I7` ([`audit/INVARIANTS.md`](../../../audit/INVARIANTS.md)). The deploy step must include an attestation that each downstream `admin` field can only operate parameters the invariants permit.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Deployment order (Phase 4 — testnet only)\n\nPhase 4 deployment is gated on Phase 2 sign-off ([`ENGAGEMENT.md`](./ENGAGEMENT.md) §6). The manifest produced by Phase 4 sets `\"environment\": \"testnet-only\"` and is never referenced from mainnet manifests until A2 verdict = `READY`.\n\n```\n11. CrossChainBridge              (no on-chain dependencies; off-chain validator set)\n12. MultiSigCard                  (no on-chain dependencies)\n13. RecurringPayments             (depends on PaymentHub)\n14. LendingProtocolCoordinator    (depends on PaymentHub; trust-bound to CoinRabbit testnet adapter)\n```\n\n### 4.1 Per-contract init parameters (Phase 4)\n\n| # | Contract | Init parameter | Source | Notes |\n|---|----------|----------------|--------|-------|\n| 11 | `CrossChainBridge` | `validator_set_root` | Hash of the bridge-validator set agreed at kickoff | Testnet validator set must NEVER overlap with mainnet validators |\n| 11 | `CrossChainBridge` | `chain_id` | Static — `-3` for TON testnet | |\n| 12 | `MultiSigCard` | `signers` | Hardware-wallet addresses agreed at kickoff | Threshold recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3 |\n| 12 | `MultiSigCard` | `threshold` | Default `2-of-3` | Must be ≥ 2 |\n| 13 | `RecurringPayments` | `payment_hub` | Address from step 4 |\n| 13 | `RecurringPayments` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n| 14 | `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | `payment_hub` | Address from step 4 |\n| 14 | `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | `lending_adapter` | `LENDING_ADAPTER_ADDRESS` env var — points at CoinRabbit-testnet adapter |\n| 14 | `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n\n---\n\n## 5. Address registration\n\nAfter every contract is deployed and verified:\n\n1. The manifest file (`deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json`) is updated by `scripts/deploy/deploy.ts` with `address`, `codeHash`, `deployTx`, and `deployBlock`.\n2. `scripts/deploy/verify.ts` is executed against the manifest. It must return `allPassed: true` before the next contract proceeds.\n3. The deployed address is appended to:\n   - [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7 (Phase 2) or §8 (Phase 4),\n   - [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) under the **TON Testnet** section,\n   - [`docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) under **TON Testnet**.\n4. The same PR commits the updated manifest and the documentation updates atomically.\n\nRe-runs of `deploy.ts` on the same commit must be no-ops: the script reads the latest manifest, detects identical code hashes, and skips already-deployed contracts (idempotency requirement NFR-1 in [`ENGAGEMENT.md`](./ENGAGEMENT.md) §8).\n\n---\n\n## 6. Trust assumptions — pre-existing testnet artefacts\n\nThe following artefacts are treated as out-of-scope dependencies. Their testnet addresses are provisioned at kickoff and recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3.\n\n| Artefact | Mainnet address | Testnet provisioning | Trust property |\n|----------|-----------------|----------------------|----------------|\n| TBC Jetton | `EQBzKrzfB2fidoQgB4EpILOF5ISDgCX0rM86txh4M3a4Eygq` | Testnet jetton (separate, NOT the mainnet token) | Standard TON jetton, immutable |\n| NFT Series 7777 collection | `EQAjHkHtt1MIoU5c7dks73Rz8NMxAA3oStSrcQ_qgn3il-Le` | Testnet NFT collection mock (mints test cards) | Provides NFT ownership oracle for `NFTAccountResolver` |\n| NFT Series 8888 collection | `EQBedyJo8oEKJEmGUaxPELXM8dQUzXN3QYx7e8WBsfu9aVQ7` | Testnet NFT collection mock | Same |\n| TONCO TBC/TON pool | `EQCUUQ4JkETDPTRLlNaMBx5vGFhMn0OC1184AfdnBKKaGK2M` | Not deployed on testnet | Adapter validation uses sandbox/quote endpoints only (see [`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md)) |\n\nTestnet TBC and testnet NFT collections **must not** share addresses or code with their mainnet counterparts. Cross-environment confusion is the single most common deployment hazard and is explicitly checked by `verify.ts` (rejects mainnet-addressed jettons in a testnet manifest).\n\n---\n\n## 7. Code hash matrix\n\n`scripts/deploy/verify.ts` computes the SHA-256 of each deployed cell and compares it to the expected hash. The expected hashes are derived from the `audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md` build artefacts. Discrepancy aborts the deployment.\n\n| Contract | Expected source | Verification step |\n|----------|-----------------|-------------------|\n| `AccountLocks` | `contracts/payments/account-locks.fc` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `NFTAccountResolver` | `contracts/nft-resolver/nft_account_resolver.fc` + `.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `AccountStateMachine` | `contracts/payment-hub/account-state.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `PaymentHub` | `contracts/payments/PaymentHub.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `MerchantPaymentHub` | `contracts/MerchantPaymentHub.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `CollateralSignal` | `contracts/CollateralSignal.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `PublicCollateralLookup` | `contracts/collateral-lookup/PublicCollateralLookup.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `ProposalRegistry` | `contracts/governance/ProposalRegistry.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `SnapshotVerifier` | `contracts/governance/SnapshotVerifier.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `TransparencyRegistry` | `contracts/governance/TransparencyRegistry.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `CrossChainBridge` | `contracts/CrossChainBridge.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `MultiSigCard` | `contracts/MultiSigCard.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `RecurringPayments` | `contracts/RecurringPayments.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | `contracts/LendingProtocolCoordinator.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n\nCode hashes are recorded in the manifest produced by the deploy run and copied into [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7 / §8 alongside the addresses.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Initialisation invariant checks\n\nAfter every contract is deployed, `verify.ts` runs the source-level invariant scan defined in `verifyInvariants` against the contract. The following patterns MUST NOT appear in any deployed contract:\n\n- `adminWithdraw` — admin withdrawal function\n- `emergencyDrain` — emergency drain function\n- `forcedTransfer` — forced-transfer function\n- `set_code(` — code upgrade function\n\nAny match aborts the deployment with a non-zero exit and rolls back the manifest entry. The behaviour is required by issue #117 §7 (\"Phase 4 contracts deployed for testing only — not to be treated as production-ready\"): even on testnet, no contract may expose a back-door fund-control path. This mirrors invariant I3 (\"No Admin Fund Control\").\n\n---\n\n## 9. Post-deploy state machine\n\nOnce every contract row in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7 has `Verified = ✅`, the deployment is treated as **Provisional**. The state transitions are:\n\n```\nProvisional  →  Validated   →  Signed-off\n     ⏬             ⏬               ⏬\n   addresses    end-to-end         STATUS verdict\n   recorded     tests pass         = READY-FOR-B2\n```\n\n- **Provisional → Validated** requires every scenario in [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §2 (E2E-1 … E2E-7) green, every adapter row in [`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md) green, and every check in [`INDEXER_VALIDATION.md`](./INDEXER_VALIDATION.md) green.\n- **Validated → Signed-off** requires explicit maintainer attestation in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §1.\n\nA roll-back from `Validated` to `Provisional` is permitted only if a Critical or High issue is discovered post-validation. The roll-back is logged in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §14.\n\n---\n\n## 10. Purpose\n\nThis document is the procedural runbook for the testnet deployment. The operator follows it step-by-step. It pairs with [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) (which contracts and parameters) and [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) (post-deploy validation).\n\nRoll-back guidance is recorded inline. The runbook intentionally separates *operations* (this file) from *gating decisions* (recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md)).\n\n---\n\n## 2. Pre-deployment checklist\n\nRun this checklist before issuing any signing key. Each row links to the doc / artefact that proves the check has passed.\n\n- [ ] **Git state**: `git status` clean, current branch matches `audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md`'s freeze commit, no uncommitted changes.\n- [ ] **Reproducible build**: `npx blueprint build` succeeds; build artefacts present in `build/`. Procedure: [`audit/BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md`](../../../audit/BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md).\n- [ ] **Tests green on deploy commit**: `npm test` and the invariant suite (`tests/invariants/`) pass on the same commit. Procedure: [`audit/TEST_COVERAGE_REPORT.md`](../../../audit/TEST_COVERAGE_REPORT.md).\n- [ ] **Pre-audit findings closed**: F-CRIT-1 … F-CRIT-5 in [`docs/audit/FULL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md`](../../audit/FULL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md) marked remediated.\n- [ ] **Key separation**: testnet deployer multi-sig is *distinct* from any mainnet key (procedure: [`docs/security/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md`](../../security/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md) §\"Per-environment separation\").\n- [ ] **Cold storage**: every multi-sig signer key is in a hardware wallet (Ledger / Trezor / cold air-gap). No hot wallets.\n- [ ] **Faucet balance**: deployer testnet balance ≥ estimated cost in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §4.\n- [ ] **Env vars set**: `ADMIN_ADDRESS`, `RISK_AUTHORITY_ADDRESS`, optional `LENDING_ADAPTER_ADDRESS` populated in the operator's shell only.\n- [ ] **No secrets in repo**: `git ls-files | xargs grep -l 'mnemonic\\\\|secret\\\\|private_key' || true` returns no real secrets — only documentation references.\n- [ ] **Manifest target writable**: `deployments/testnet/` exists and is writable.\n\nIf any row is unchecked the operator MUST stop and resolve the row before touching a signing key.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Key management\n\n### 3.1 Required keys\n\n| Role | Owner | Storage | Used for |\n|------|-------|---------|----------|\n| Deployer multi-sig signer #1 | `@konard` | Hardware wallet, cold storage | Multi-sig deploy approve |\n| Deployer multi-sig signer #2 | TBD | Hardware wallet, cold storage | Multi-sig deploy approve |\n| Deployer multi-sig signer #3 | TBD | Hardware wallet, cold storage | Multi-sig deploy approve (3-of-3 quorum; 2-of-3 fallback per [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3) |\n| Admin address (testnet) | `@konard` | Multi-sig | Owner of `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n| Risk authority (testnet) | TBD | Separate multi-sig — must NOT equal Admin | Owner of `RISK_AUTHORITY_ADDRESS` env var |\n| Gateway sandbox API keys | `@konard` | Encrypted environment file, never committed | `backend/adapters/` only |\n\n### 3.2 Anti-foot-gun rules\n\n1. The deployer signer key MUST NOT equal any mainnet signer key. The operator confirms this in writing in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3 before kickoff.\n2. The deployer multi-sig MUST NOT control mainnet contracts. The verification step in §6 confirms this.\n3. A single-key deployment is permitted only for purely-experimental contracts whose addresses will not appear in `docs/existing-contracts.md`. For every Phase 2 contract a multi-sig deploy is **required** (NFR-4 in [`ENGAGEMENT.md`](./ENGAGEMENT.md) §8).\n4. Phase 4 contracts deployed on testnet must inherit the same key constraints. The fact that Phase 4 is `testing-only` does NOT relax key separation.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Idempotency contract\n\nThe deployment must be safe to re-run. Idempotency is enforced at two layers:\n\n- **Deterministic addressing**: the constructor parameters in [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) §3.1 and §4.1 produce a deterministic address per (contract, deployer, init data). Re-deploy of the same contract on the same commit and same deployer recomputes the same address.\n- **Manifest comparison**: `scripts/deploy/deploy.ts` loads the latest manifest at `deployments/testnet/`, compares each contract's computed address against the manifest, and **skips** the deploy step if (address, codeHash) match. A mismatch (different codeHash for the same address) aborts the run and prints the diff.\n\nPractical consequence: an operator can run `deploy.ts` as many times as needed without producing duplicate deployments. Each re-run produces an audit-trail manifest pointing at the same addresses, with `deployedAt` reflecting the original deploy timestamp.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Dry run\n\nA dry run is mandatory before any signing key is touched. The operator runs:\n\n```bash\n# Phase 2 dry run\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network testnet --dry-run\n\n# Phase 4 dry run\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network testnet --dry-run --phase4\n```\n\nExpected output:\n\n1. The script prints every contract in the configured order with the `[DRY RUN] Would deploy: <ContractName>` line.\n2. Every pre-deployment check in `checkPreDeploymentRequirements()` passes (or surfaces the specific failure with a remediation link).\n3. A dry-run manifest is written to `deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` with the `dryRun: true` flag. This file is *not* committed.\n\nThe operator records the dry-run timestamp in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §5 (row 3 / row 11) before proceeding.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Real deployment\n\n### 6.1 Phase 2\n\n1. Confirm every row in §2 is ✅ and every row in §3.1 is provisioned.\n2. From the dry-run output, copy the deployment-budget estimate to [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §4 and confirm the faucet balance covers it.\n3. Run the deploy script live:\n\n   ```bash\n   npx ts-node scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network testnet\n   ```\n\n4. Each contract's deploy transaction is signed by the deployer multi-sig. The operator approves each signer step from a separate hardware wallet.\n5. After each contract:\n   - The manifest at `deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` gains a new entry.\n   - `scripts/deploy/verify.ts --manifest deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` is executed. The run must return `allPassed: true` before the next contract.\n   - The deployed address is copied into [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7, [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md), and [`docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md).\n6. Phase 2 sign-off is recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §5 row 10 once every Phase 2 row in §7 has `Verified = ✅` and the validation pass in [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §2 is green.\n\n### 6.2 Phase 4\n\nPhase 4 is initiated **only after Phase 2 sign-off**. It writes a separate manifest:\n\n```bash\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network testnet --phase4\n```\n\nThe manifest produced by Phase 4 carries `\"environment\": \"testnet-only\"`. The verification step in §6 of [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) rejects this manifest if pointed at the mainnet RPC.\n\n### 6.3 Post-deploy verification\n\nAfter both phases:\n\n```bash\n# Combined verification — Phase 2\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/verify.ts --manifest deployments/testnet/<phase2-timestamp>.json\n\n# Combined verification — Phase 4\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/verify.ts --manifest deployments/testnet/<phase4-timestamp>.json\n```\n\nBoth runs must return `allPassed: true`. The verification report (`.verification.json`) is committed alongside the manifest.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Update documentation atomically\n\nIn the same PR that ships the manifest:\n\n1. [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) — add the deployed testnet addresses under the **TON Testnet** section.\n2. [`docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) and [`network-matrix.json`](../network-matrix.json) — populate the `## TON Testnet` block with the same addresses; preserve the **append-only** rule from the matrix preamble.\n3. [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) — populate §7 / §8, attach SHA-256 of the manifest in §10.\n4. `CHANGELOG.md` — add an Unreleased entry under `### Added — B1 Testnet Deployment` with the contract names and a link back to this engagement.\n\nCommit message format: `chore(deploy): testnet B1 — <contract or batch> deployed`.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Roll-back\n\nIf a Critical/High issue is found between deploy and sign-off:\n\n1. Pause: mark the manifest with `paused: true` and add a row in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §13 (\"Accepted deferrals\" / \"Open questions\").\n2. Do **not** delete the manifest. Manifests are append-only — corrections add new entries with explicit supersession notes (mirrors [`network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) preamble).\n3. File a GitHub issue using the standard workflow ([`docs/security/audits/REMEDIATION_WORKFLOW.md`](../../security/audits/REMEDIATION_WORKFLOW.md) §3.2) — even though B1 is not a security audit, this workflow is the canonical finding-management process.\n4. Once the remediation lands, re-run `deploy.ts` on the new commit. The new addresses replace the paused ones in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7 / §8 with the original entries kept for audit trail.\n5. Validation must be re-run end-to-end against the new addresses.\n\nA roll-back **never** mutates an already-emitted manifest in place.\n\n---\n\n## 9. CI integration\n\nA separate workflow `.github/workflows/testnet-integration.yml` (planned in roadmap **B3**) runs the validation suite from [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §2 nightly against the latest testnet manifest. Until that workflow is wired, the operator runs the suite manually:\n\n```bash\nnpm run test:integration:testnet\n```\n\nThe CI green badge is a prerequisite for `READY-FOR-B2` (acceptance criterion 4 in [`ENGAGEMENT.md`](./ENGAGEMENT.md) §1).\n\n---\n\n## 10.    [solve worker-1]     "content": "# B1 — Testnet Deployment Runbook\n\n**Engagement:** [B1](./ENGAGEMENT.md)\n**Status:** Procedure frozen — followed verbatim at kickoff\n**Owner:** `@konard`\n**Last Updated:** 2026-05-16\n\n---\n\n## 1. Purpose\n\nThis document is the procedural runbook for the testnet deployment. The operator follows it step-by-step. It pairs with [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) (which contracts and parameters) and [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) (post-deploy validation).\n\nRoll-back guidance is recorded inline. The runbook intentionally separates *operations* (this file) from *gating decisions* (recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md)).\n\n---\n\n## 2. Pre-deployment checklist\n\nRun this checklist before issuing any signing key. Each row links to the doc / artefact that proves the check has passed.\n\n- [ ] **Git state**: `git status` clean, current branch matches `audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md`'s freeze commit, no uncommitted changes.\n- [ ] **Reproducible build**: `npx blueprint build` succeeds; build artefacts present in `build/`. Procedure: [`audit/BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md`](../../../audit/BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md).\n- [ ] **Tests green on deploy commit**: `npm test` and the invariant suite (`tests/invariants/`) pass on the same commit. Procedure: [`audit/TEST_COVERAGE_REPORT.md`](../../../audit/TEST_COVERAGE_REPORT.md).\n- [ ] **Pre-audit findings closed**: F-CRIT-1 … F-CRIT-5 in [`docs/audit/FULL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md`](../../audit/FULL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md) marked remediated.\n- [ ] **Key separation**: testnet deployer multi-sig is *distinct* from any mainnet key (procedure: [`docs/security/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md`](../../security/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md) §\"Per-environment separation\").\n- [ ] **Cold storage**: every multi-sig signer key is in a hardware wallet (Ledger / Trezor / cold air-gap). No hot wallets.\n- [ ] **Faucet balance**: deployer testnet balance ≥ estimated cost in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §4.\n- [ ] **Env vars set**: `ADMIN_ADDRESS`, `RISK_AUTHORITY_ADDRESS`, optional `LENDING_ADAPTER_ADDRESS` populated in the operator's shell only.\n- [ ] **No secrets in repo**: `git ls-files | xargs grep -l 'mnemonic\\\\|secret\\\\|private_key' || true` returns no real secrets — only documentation references.\n- [ ] **Manifest target writable**: `deployments/testnet/` exists and is writable.\n\nIf any row is unchecked the operator MUST stop and resolve the row before touching a signing key.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Key management\n\n### 3.1 Required keys\n\n| Role | Owner | Storage | Used for |\n|------|-------|---------|----------|\n| Deployer multi-sig signer #1 | `@konard` | Hardware wallet, cold storage | Multi-sig deploy approve |\n| Deployer multi-sig signer #2 | TBD | Hardware wallet, cold storage | Multi-sig deploy approve |\n| Deployer multi-sig signer #3 | TBD | Hardware wallet, cold storage | Multi-sig deploy approve (3-of-3 quorum; 2-of-3 fallback per [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3) |\n| Admin address (testnet) | `@konard` | Multi-sig | Owner of `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n| Risk authority (testnet) | TBD | Separate multi-sig — must NOT equal Admin | Owner of `RISK_AUTHORITY_ADDRESS` env var |\n| Gateway sandbox API keys | `@konard` | Encrypted environment file, never committed | `backend/adapters/` only |\n\n### 3.2 Anti-foot-gun rules\n\n1. The deployer signer key MUST NOT equal any mainnet signer key. The operator confirms this in writing in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3 before kickoff.\n2. The deployer multi-sig MUST NOT control mainnet contracts. The verification step in §6 confirms this.\n3. A single-key deployment is permitted only for purely-experimental contracts whose addresses will not appear in `docs/existing-contracts.md`. For every Phase 2 contract a multi-sig deploy is **required** (NFR-4 in [`ENGAGEMENT.md`](./ENGAGEMENT.md) §8).\n4. Phase 4 contracts deployed on testnet must inherit the same key constraints. The fact that Phase 4 is `testing-only` does NOT relax key separation.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Idempotency contract\n\nThe deployment must be safe to re-run. Idempotency is enforced at two layers:\n\n- **Deterministic addressing**: the constructor parameters in [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) §3.1 and §4.1 produce a deterministic address per (contract, deployer, init data). Re-deploy of the same contract on the same commit and same deployer recomputes the same address.\n- **Manifest comparison**: `scripts/deploy/deploy.ts` loads the latest manifest at `deployments/testnet/`, compares each contract's computed address against the manifest, and **skips** the deploy step if (address, codeHash) match. A mismatch (different codeHash for the same address) aborts the run and prints the diff.\n\nPractical consequence: an operator can run `deploy.ts` as many times as needed without producing duplicate deployments. Each re-run produces an audit-trail manifest pointing at the same addresses, with `deployedAt` reflecting the original deploy timestamp.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Dry run\n\nA dry run is mandatory before any signing key is touched. The operator runs:\n\n```bash\n# Phase 2 dry run\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network testnet --dry-run\n\n# Phase 4 dry run\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network testnet --dry-run --phase4\n```\n\nExpected output:\n\n1. The script prints every contract in the configured order with the `[DRY RUN] Would deploy: <ContractName>` line.\n2. Every pre-deployment check in `checkPreDeploymentRequirements()` passes (or surfaces the specific failure with a remediation link).\n3. A dry-run manifest is written to `deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` with the `dryRun: true` flag. This file is *not* committed.\n\nThe operator records the dry-run timestamp in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §5 (row 3 / row 11) before proceeding.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Real deployment\n\n### 6.1 Phase 2\n\n1. Confirm every row in §2 is ✅ and every row in §3.1 is provisioned.\n2. From the dry-run output, copy the deployment-budget estimate to [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §4 and confirm the faucet balance covers it.\n3. Run the deploy script live:\n\n   ```bash\n   npx ts-node scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network testnet\n   ```\n\n4. Each contract's deploy transaction is signed by the deployer multi-sig. The operator approves each signer step from a separate hardware wallet.\n5. After each contract:\n   - The manifest at `deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` gains a new entry.\n   - `scripts/deploy/verify.ts --manifest deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json` is executed. The run must return `allPassed: true` before the next contract.\n   - The deployed address is copied into [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7, [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md), and [`docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md).\n6. Phase 2 sign-off is recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §5 row 10 once every Phase 2 row in §7 has `Verified = ✅` and the validation pass in [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §2 is green.\n\n### 6.2 Phase 4\n\nPhase 4 is initiated **only after Phase 2 sign-off**. It writes a separate manifest:\n\n```bash\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/deploy.ts --network testnet --phase4\n```\n\nThe manifest produced by Phase 4 carries `\"environment\": \"testnet-only\"`. The verification step in §6 of [`DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md`](./DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md) rejects this manifest if pointed at the mainnet RPC.\n\n### 6.3 Post-deploy verification\n\nAfter both phases:\n\n```bash\n# Combined verification — Phase 2\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/verify.ts --manifest deployments/testnet/<phase2-timestamp>.json\n\n# Combined verification — Phase 4\nnpx ts-node scripts/deploy/verify.ts --manifest deployments/testnet/<phase4-timestamp>.json\n```\n\nBoth runs must return `allPassed: true`. The verification report (`.verification.json`) is committed alongside the manifest.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Update documentation atomically\n\nIn the same PR that ships the manifest:\n\n1. [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) — add the deployed testnet addresses under the **TON Testnet** section.\n2. [`docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) and [`network-matrix.json`](../network-matrix.json) — populate the `## TON Testnet` block with the same addresses; preserve the **append-only** rule from the matrix preamble.\n3. [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) — populate §7 / §8, attach SHA-256 of the manifest in §10.\n4. `CHANGELOG.md` — add an Unreleased entry under `### Added — B1 Testnet Deployment` with the contract names and a link back to this engagement.\n\nCommit message format: `chore(deploy): testnet B1 — <contract or batch> deployed`.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Roll-back\n\nIf a Critical/High issue is found between deploy and sign-off:\n\n1. Pause: mark the manifest with `paused: true` and add a row in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §13 (\"Accepted deferrals\" / \"Open questions\").\n2. Do **not** delete the manifest. Manifests are append-only — corrections add new entries with explicit supersession notes (mirrors [`network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) preamble).\n3. File a GitHub issue using the standard workflow ([`docs/security/audits/REMEDIATION_WORKFLOW.md`](../../security/audits/REMEDIATION_WORKFLOW.md) §3.2) — even though B1 is not a security audit, this workflow is the canonical finding-management process.\n4. Once the remediation lands, re-run `deploy.ts` on the new commit. The new addresses replace the paused ones in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7 / §8 with the original entries kept for audit trail.\n5. Validation must be re-run end-to-end against the new addresses.\n\nA roll-back **never** mutates an already-emitted manifest in place.\n\n---\n\n## 9. CI integration\n\nA separate workflow `.github/workflows/testnet-integration.yml` (planned in roadmap **B3**) runs the validation suite from [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §2 nightly against the latest testnet manifest. Until that workflow is wired, the operator runs the suite manually:\n\n```bash\nnpm run test:integration:testnet\n```\n\nThe CI green badge is a prerequisite for `READY-FOR-B2` (acceptance criterion 4 in [`ENGAGEMENT.md`](./ENGAGEMENT.md) §1).\n\n---\n\n## 10.    [solve worker-1]           "content": "# B1 — Testnet Validation Plan\n\n**Engagement:** [B1](./ENGAGEMENT.md)\n**Status:** Plan frozen — executed against the live testnet deployment\n**Owner:** `@konard`\n**Last Updated:** 2026-05-16\n\n---\n\n## 1. Purpose\n\nThis document specifies the validation suite that runs against the live testnet deployment produced by [`RUNBOOK.md`](./RUNBOOK.md) §6. The suite is the source of truth for acceptance criteria #4 (\"End-to-end integration test suite passes against testnet contracts\") in [`ENGAGEMENT.md`](./ENGAGEMENT.md) §1.\n\nThe suite covers:\n\n- §2: End-to-end payment scenarios on the deployed Phase 2 contracts.\n- §3: Merchant API integration against the deployed `MerchantPaymentHub`.\n- §4: SDK happy-path integration against the deployed contracts.\n- §5: Phase 4 testnet-only smoke tests (gated on Phase 2 sign-off).\n- §6: CI integration job that re-runs the suite continuously.\n\nScenario results are mirrored in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §9. Each row in the live status doc carries an `⏳ / ✅ / ❌` marker and the tx hash for traceability.\n\n---\n\n## 2. End-to-end payment scenarios (Phase 2)\n\nEach scenario is an automated test in `tests/integration/testnet/` (created against the live deployment). The tests are parameterised by the manifest at `deployments/testnet/<phase2>.json` so re-deployment to a new manifest does not require code changes.\n\n### E2E-1 — NFT ownership resolution via `PaymentHub`\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Pre-state | Test wallet owns NFT card minted from the testnet Series 7777 mock |\n| Action | Wallet calls `PaymentHub.resolveOwner(nftAddr)` |\n| Expected | Resolver returns the wallet's address; mismatched callers return `null` |\n| Invariant attested | I2 (NFT = account authority) |\n\n### E2E-2 — Atomic internal transfer\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Pre-state | Two NFT accounts A, B; A holds 100 TBC, B holds 0 |\n| Action | A initiates `transfer(B, 25)` |\n| Expected | A = 75, B = 25, single transaction, no intermediate observable state |\n| Invariant attested | I4 (atomicity), I5 (ledger conservation) |\n\n### E2E-3 — Merchant invoice creation\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Pre-state | Merchant SDK initialised against testnet `MerchantPaymentHub` |\n| Action | `merchant.createInvoice({ amount: 10 TBC, expiresIn: 600 })` |\n| Expected | Invoice ID returned, status `pending`, expiry recorded |\n| Notes | Merchant API documented in [`api/`](../../../api/) |\n\n### E2E-4 — Merchant invoice settlement\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Pre-state | Invoice from E2E-3 + payer NFT account with sufficient TBC |\n| Action | Payer wallet calls `MerchantPaymentHub.settle(invoiceId)` |\n| Expected | Status flips to `settled`; on-chain event indexed by the indexer |\n| Invariants attested | I1, I4, I7 |\n\n### E2E-5 — Lock blocks outgoing transfer\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Pre-state | Account A with `FRAUD_LOCK` flag set by `risk_authority` |\n| Action | A attempts `PaymentHub.transfer(B, 1)` |\n| Expected | Transaction reverts; flag remains set; no balance change; observable `LockedOut` event |\n| Invariant attested | I6 (Lock ≠ confiscation), I7 (Lock enforcement) |\n\n### E2E-6 — Collateral signal round-trip\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Pre-state | Account A with NFT in good standing |\n| Action | A emits a `CollateralSignal`; client reads via `PublicCollateralLookup` |\n| Expected | Lookup returns the signal payload verbatim; no admin write path exists |\n| Invariant attested | I3 (No admin fund control — verified by absence of admin write methods on the lookup) |\n\n### E2E-7 — Governance proposal lifecycle\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Pre-state | `ProposalRegistry`, `SnapshotVerifier`, `TransparencyRegistry` deployed |\n| Action | Submit proposal → snapshot verify → record transparency entry |\n| Expected | Lifecycle completes deterministically; no funds moved |\n| Invariant attested | I3 |\n\nThe seven scenarios above are the **happy paths**. Adversarial scenarios (replays, malformed payloads, lock circumvention) are covered by the existing local test suites under `tests/` and are re-asserted against testnet using the same harness pointed at the testnet RPC.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Merchant API integration\n\nThe Merchant API ([`api/`](../../../api/)) is re-tested against the live testnet contracts. The test command:\n\n```bash\nnpm run test:integration:testnet --workspace api\n```\n\nCoverage:\n\n| # | Test | Expected |\n|---|------|----------|\n| API-1 | Invoice creation endpoint (`POST /invoices`) writes the invoice to the in-memory store and emits the on-chain side effect via `MerchantPaymentHub` | 200 OK; invoice ID; on-chain tx hash returned |\n| API-2 | Idempotency key reuse for invoice creation | 409 with the original invoice ID |\n| API-3 | Settlement webhook signature verification | 401 on signature mismatch; 200 on valid |\n| API-4 | Read-only invoice status endpoint surfaces indexer state, not API state | Status reflects on-chain truth |\n\nAll Merchant API integration tests reuse the existing fixtures under `api/tests/` and switch the RPC endpoint via the `TON_NETWORK=testnet` env var.\n\n---\n\n## 4. SDK integration\n\nThe Merchant SDK ([`sdk/`](../../../sdk/)) provides the canonical merchant-facing surface. The test command:\n\n```bash\nnpm run test:integration:testnet --workspace sdk\n```\n\nCoverage:\n\n| # | Test | Expected |\n|---|------|----------|\n| SDK-1 | `MerchantClient.createInvoice` round-trip against testnet `MerchantPaymentHub` | Invoice created and settled deterministically |\n| SDK-2 | `MerchantClient.verifySettlement` reads on-chain state via indexer | Settlement observed within indexer SLA (see [`INDEXER_VALIDATION.md`](./INDEXER_VALIDATION.md)) |\n| SDK-3 | SDK error surfaces for invalid invoice IDs | Typed error matches `SDK_ERR_INVOICE_NOT_FOUND` |\n| SDK-4 | SDK error surfaces for locked payer accounts | Typed error matches `SDK_ERR_ACCOUNT_LOCKED` |\n\n---\n\n## 5. Phase 4 testnet-only smoke tests\n\nPhase 4 contracts are tested against the same harness with the `testnet-only` manifest. Tests for Phase 4 mark themselves as `non-blocking-for-mainnet` — they validate behaviour on testnet, not readiness for mainnet (mainnet readiness for Phase 4 requires A2).\n\n| # | Contract | Smoke test | Expected |\n|---|----------|------------|----------|\n| P4-1 | `CrossChainBridge` | Issue a bridge message; validator signs; recipient receives placeholder receipt | Lifecycle completes; replay rejected |\n| P4-2 | `MultiSigCard` | M-of-N approval flow | Threshold honoured; cancel path works |\n| P4-3 | `RecurringPayments` | Schedule + execute one cycle | Payment debited; subsequent cycle obeys cadence |\n| P4-4 | `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | Adapter handshake against CoinRabbit testnet | Round-trip OK; no fund custody by coordinator |\n\nFailures here block Phase 4 sign-off but do **not** block Phase 2 sign-off (Phase 2 has its own gating from §2–§4 of this document).\n\n---\n\n## 6. CI integration\n\nA single workflow runs the suite against the latest manifest:\n\n```bash\nnpm run test:integration:testnet\n```\n\nThe command:\n\n1. Reads `deployments/testnet/<latest>.json`.\n2. Bootstraps test wallets from a sandbox faucet (sandbox-only, never mainnet keys).\n3. Executes §2 (E2E-1 … E2E-7), §3 (API-1 … API-4), §4 (SDK-1 … SDK-4), §5 (P4-1 … P4-4 — conditional on Phase 4 manifest present).\n4. Writes a summary report to `deployments/testnet/<manifest>.integration.json`.\n\nA green run is the **necessary** signal for sign-off. The CI job is owned by roadmap B3 (Production Monitoring & Alerting) — until B3 wires the workflow, the operator runs the command manually and attaches the integration report to [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §10.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Failure handling\n\nA failure in §2 / §3 / §4 / §5 raises an entry in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §13 and follows the workflow at [`docs/security/audits/REMEDIATION_WORKFLOW.md`](../../security/audits/REMEDIATION_WORKFLOW.md) §3. Critical/High failures pause B1 and block Phase 4 deployment (if not yet performed) and `READY-FOR-B2` (if already deployed).\n\n---\n\n## 8. Engagement Process\n129\t\n130\t```\n131\tT-0   Engagement plan committed                                            ✅ (this directory)\n132\tT+0   All upstream gates G-1 … G-6 closed                                   ⏳\n133\tT+0d  Phase 2 dry run on testnet sandbox (--dry-run, no signing)            ⏳\n134\tT+1d  Phase 2 multi-sig deploy + manifest written + post-deploy verify     ⏳\n135\tT+1d  Update `docs/existing-contracts.md` and `docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`\n136\tT+2d  End-to-end validation pass (VALIDATION_PLAN.md §2 — happy paths)      ⏳\n137\tT+2d  Gateway adapter validation pass (GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md)               ⏳\n138\tT+3d  Indexer validation pass (INDEXER_VALIDATION.md)                       ⏳\n139\tT+3d  Phase 2 sign-off recorded in STATUS.md                                ⏳\n140\tT+4d  Phase 4 dry run                                                       ⏳\n141\tT+4d  Phase 4 multi-sig deploy (testnet-only label)                         ⏳\n142\tT+5d  Phase 4 validation pass + sign-off                                    ⏳\n143\tT+5d  CI integration suite green against testnet (`tests/integration:testnet`) ⏳\n144\tT+5d  STATUS.md gating verdict flipped to READY-FOR-B2                      ⏳\n145\t```\n146\t\n147\tPhase 4 testnet deployment is **only initiated after Phase 2 is signed off**. Security Requirements\n152\t\n153\tThe following constraints from issue #117 §7 are non-negotiable:\n154\t\n155\t1. **Key separation.** Testnet deployer key MUST be a distinct multi-sig (or hardware wallet) separate from any mainnet key. Initialisation invariant checks\n156\t\n157\tAfter every contract is deployed, `verify.ts` runs the source-level invariant scan defined in `verifyInvariants` against the contract. The following patterns MUST NOT appear in any deployed contract:\n158\t\n159\t- `adminWithdraw` — admin withdrawal function\n160\t- `emergencyDrain` — emergency drain function\n161\t- `forcedTransfer` — forced-transfer function\n162\t- `set_code(` — code upgrade function\n163\t\n164\tAny match aborts the deployment with a non-zero exit and rolls back the manifest entry. The behaviour is required by issue #117 §7 (\"Phase 4 contracts deployed for testing only — not to be treated as production-ready\"): even on testnet, no contract may expose a back-door fund-control path. This mirrors invariant I3 (\"No Admin Fund Control\").\n165\t\n166\t---\n167\t\n168\t## 9. Post-deploy state machine\n169\t\n170\tOnce every contract row in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7 has `Verified = ✅`, the deployment is treated as **Provisional**. The state transitions are:\n171\t\n172\t```\n173\tProvisional  →  Validated   →  Signed-off\n174\t     ⏬             ⏬               ⏬\n175\t   addresses    end-to-end         STATUS verdict\n176\t   recorded     tests pass         = READY-FOR-B2\n177\t```\n178\t\n179\t- **Provisional → Validated** requires every scenario in [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §2 (E2E-1 … E2E-7) green, every adapter row in [`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md) green, and every check in [`INDEXER_VALIDATION.md`](./INDEXER_VALIDATION.md) green.\n180\t- **Validated → Signed-off** requires explicit maintainer attestation in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §1.\n181\t\n182\tA roll-back from `Validated` to `Provisional` is permitted only if a Critical or High issue is discovered post-validation. The roll-back is logged in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §14.\n183\t\n184\t---\n185\t\n186\t## 10. The deploy step must include an attestation that each downstream `admin` field can only operate parameters the invariants permit.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Deployment order (Phase 4 — testnet only)\n\nPhase 4 deployment is gated on Phase 2 sign-off ([`ENGAGEMENT.md`](./ENGAGEMENT.md) §6). The manifest produced by Phase 4 sets `\"environment\": \"testnet-only\"` and is never referenced from mainnet manifests until A2 verdict = `READY`.\n\n```\n11. CrossChainBridge              (no on-chain dependencies; off-chain validator set)\n12. MultiSigCard                  (no on-chain dependencies)\n13. RecurringPayments             (depends on PaymentHub)\n14. LendingProtocolCoordinator    (depends on PaymentHub; trust-bound to CoinRabbit testnet adapter)\n```\n\n### 4.1 Per-contract init parameters (Phase 4)\n\n| # | Contract | Init parameter | Source | Notes |\n|---|----------|----------------|--------|-------|\n| 11 | `CrossChainBridge` | `validator_set_root` | Hash of the bridge-validator set agreed at kickoff | Testnet validator set must NEVER overlap with mainnet validators |\n| 11 | `CrossChainBridge` | `chain_id` | Static — `-3` for TON testnet | |\n| 12 | `MultiSigCard` | `signers` | Hardware-wallet addresses agreed at kickoff | Threshold recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3 |\n| 12 | `MultiSigCard` | `threshold` | Default `2-of-3` | Must be ≥ 2 |\n| 13 | `RecurringPayments` | `payment_hub` | Address from step 4 |\n| 13 | `RecurringPayments` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n| 14 | `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | `payment_hub` | Address from step 4 |\n| 14 | `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | `lending_adapter` | `LENDING_ADAPTER_ADDRESS` env var — points at CoinRabbit-testnet adapter |\n| 14 | `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | `admin` | `ADMIN_ADDRESS` env var |\n\n---\n\n## 5. Address registration\n\nAfter every contract is deployed and verified:\n\n1. The manifest file (`deployments/testnet/<timestamp>.json`) is updated by `scripts/deploy/deploy.ts` with `address`, `codeHash`, `deployTx`, and `deployBlock`.\n2. `scripts/deploy/verify.ts` is executed against the manifest. It must return `allPassed: true` before the next contract proceeds.\n3. The deployed address is appended to:\n   - [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7 (Phase 2) or §8 (Phase 4),\n   - [`docs/existing-contracts.md`](../../existing-contracts.md) under the **TON Testnet** section,\n   - [`docs/deployments/network-matrix.md`](../network-matrix.md) under **TON Testnet**.\n4. The same PR commits the updated manifest and the documentation updates atomically.\n\nRe-runs of `deploy.ts` on the same commit must be no-ops: the script reads the latest manifest, detects identical code hashes, and skips already-deployed contracts (idempotency requirement NFR-1 in [`ENGAGEMENT.md`](./ENGAGEMENT.md) §8).\n\n---\n\n## 6. Trust assumptions — pre-existing testnet artefacts\n\nThe following artefacts are treated as out-of-scope dependencies. Their testnet addresses are provisioned at kickoff and recorded in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §3.\n\n| Artefact | Mainnet address | Testnet provisioning | Trust property |\n|----------|-----------------|----------------------|----------------|\n| TBC Jetton | `EQBzKrzfB2fidoQgB4EpILOF5ISDgCX0rM86txh4M3a4Eygq` | Testnet jetton (separate, NOT the mainnet token) | Standard TON jetton, immutable |\n| NFT Series 7777 collection | `EQAjHkHtt1MIoU5c7dks73Rz8NMxAA3oStSrcQ_qgn3il-Le` | Testnet NFT collection mock (mints test cards) | Provides NFT ownership oracle for `NFTAccountResolver` |\n| NFT Series 8888 collection | `EQBedyJo8oEKJEmGUaxPELXM8dQUzXN3QYx7e8WBsfu9aVQ7` | Testnet NFT collection mock | Same |\n| TONCO TBC/TON pool | `EQCUUQ4JkETDPTRLlNaMBx5vGFhMn0OC1184AfdnBKKaGK2M` | Not deployed on testnet | Adapter validation uses sandbox/quote endpoints only (see [`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md)) |\n\nTestnet TBC and testnet NFT collections **must not** share addresses or code with their mainnet counterparts. Cross-environment confusion is the single most common deployment hazard and is explicitly checked by `verify.ts` (rejects mainnet-addressed jettons in a testnet manifest).\n\n---\n\n## 7. Code hash matrix\n\n`scripts/deploy/verify.ts` computes the SHA-256 of each deployed cell and compares it to the expected hash. The expected hashes are derived from the `audit/FREEZE_METADATA.md` build artefacts. Discrepancy aborts the deployment.\n\n| Contract | Expected source | Verification step |\n|----------|-----------------|-------------------|\n| `AccountLocks` | `contracts/payments/account-locks.fc` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `NFTAccountResolver` | `contracts/nft-resolver/nft_account_resolver.fc` + `.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `AccountStateMachine` | `contracts/payment-hub/account-state.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `PaymentHub` | `contracts/payments/PaymentHub.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `MerchantPaymentHub` | `contracts/MerchantPaymentHub.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `CollateralSignal` | `contracts/CollateralSignal.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `PublicCollateralLookup` | `contracts/collateral-lookup/PublicCollateralLookup.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `ProposalRegistry` | `contracts/governance/ProposalRegistry.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `SnapshotVerifier` | `contracts/governance/SnapshotVerifier.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `TransparencyRegistry` | `contracts/governance/TransparencyRegistry.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `CrossChainBridge` | `contracts/CrossChainBridge.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `MultiSigCard` | `contracts/MultiSigCard.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `RecurringPayments` | `contracts/RecurringPayments.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n| `LendingProtocolCoordinator` | `contracts/LendingProtocolCoordinator.tact` | `verify.ts` §`verifyCodeHash` |\n\nCode hashes are recorded in the manifest produced by the deploy run and copied into [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7 / §8 alongside the addresses.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Initialisation invariant checks\n\nAfter every contract is deployed, `verify.ts` runs the source-level invariant scan defined in `verifyInvariants` against the contract. The following patterns MUST NOT appear in any deployed contract:\n\n- `adminWithdraw` — admin withdrawal function\n- `emergencyDrain` — emergency drain function\n- `forcedTransfer` — forced-transfer function\n- `set_code(` — code upgrade function\n\nAny match aborts the deployment with a non-zero exit and rolls back the manifest entry. The behaviour is required by issue #117 §7 (\"Phase 4 contracts deployed for testing only — not to be treated as production-ready\"): even on testnet, no contract may expose a back-door fund-control path. This mirrors invariant I3 (\"No Admin Fund Control\").\n\n---\n\n## 9. Post-deploy state machine\n\nOnce every contract row in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §7 has `Verified = ✅`, the deployment is treated as **Provisional**. The state transitions are:\n\n```\nProvisional  →  Validated   →  Signed-off\n     ⏬             ⏬               ⏬\n   addresses    end-to-end         STATUS verdict\n   recorded     tests pass         = READY-FOR-B2\n```\n\n- **Provisional → Validated** requires every scenario in [`VALIDATION_PLAN.md`](./VALIDATION_PLAN.md) §2 (E2E-1 … E2E-7) green, every adapter row in [`GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md`](./GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md) green, and every check in [`INDEXER_VALIDATION.md`](./INDEXER_VALIDATION.md) green.\n- **Validated → Signed-off** requires explicit maintainer attestation in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §1.\n\nA roll-back from `Validated` to `Provisional` is permitted only if a Critical or High issue is discovered post-validation. The roll-back is logged in [`STATUS.md`](./STATUS.md) §14.\n\n---\n\n## 10.
